# ADR-3208: AWS iam: Sts assume-role without external ID for partner 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Missing external IDs enable confused deputy.

## Decision

Cross-account trusts MUST NOT allow sts assume-role without external ID for partner 8 (AWS-iam-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

ExternalId conditions are mandatory for partners.
